tools.name: search
tools.description: Work With Indies RSS 2.0 feed (latest ~100 jobs at independent game studios). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). title is '<studio> is hiring a <role> to work from <location>'. id is the job link.
